summary.text: Christina Mitchell is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 110, in office since December 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Jason Copp. An educator, Ballotpedia lists Maine School Administrative District 51 among her prior offices.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell earned a bachelor's degree from Bowdoin College in 1984 and a graduate degree from Brown University in 1986, and her career experience includes working as an educator.
She took office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Stephen Moriarty.
